goal: Create a canonical, observable and privacy-safe path from qualified enquiry to signed contract + deposit.
stop_conditions: Web agent must not invent a competing lead schema before CRM contract lock.
Do not send raw PII to analytics/ad platforms outside a documented lawful integration.
Do not call a lead WON without the canonical won-condition approved by Mission Control.
Do not automate contract/pricing exceptions without human approval.
promotion_rule: A synthetic/test lead can traverse landing → validated capture → CRM → qualification → consultation/proposal → contract/deposit state with attribution, idempotency and privacy checks observable end to end.
